findings.title: Primary chart lower-panel y-axis labels clip at the left edge
findings.exact_reproduction: On native Windows at logical 1600x900, open Dashboard, Index Graph, 종목 차트 (005930), and 미국 ETF (SPY); inspect the left edge of volume/indicator lower panels.
findings.expected: Every rotated y-axis title and tick label is fully readable inside the viewport.
findings.actual: The first characters and/or tick labels are cut by the left viewport boundary; the defect repeats on multiple primary chart surfaces.
likely_code_scope: src/stock_data/gui/main_window.py: chart layouts/margins for DashboardPage, IndexPage, IndividualEquityPage
likely_test_scope: tests/unit/gui/test_gui_backtest.py: 1600x900 primary-chart fit and pixel-bound assertions
dedup_hints: Search Canonical Queue for left-axis, volume label, chart clipping, 1600x900.

findings.title: Data Status summary-card detail text is vertically clipped
findings.exact_reproduction: Open Data Status at native logical 1600x900 after the local status reread completes; inspect the four summary cards above 통합 갱신 상태.
findings.expected: Each card shows its complete summary/status text or uses an explicit expandable/ellipsis affordance.
findings.actual: Second/third lines are visibly cut at the fixed card bottom, obscuring current counts/status context.
dedup_hints: Search Canonical Queue for Data Status summary card clipping or fixed height.

findings.title: Selected-equity detail text and right-rail controls clip at 1600x900
findings.exact_reproduction: Search 005930 or SPY with real mouse/key events, select the exact result, click 차트 보기, and inspect the identity card, source text, and bottom right-rail buttons at 1600x900.
findings.expected: Identity/source text and all button captions remain fully readable without overlap or truncation.
findings.actual: Identity/source lines are cut vertically; the bottom of the right rail clips the 아래 control caption. The selected-symbol error state remains understandable but materially harder to scan.
findings.latency_feedback: Immediate after the local chart worker completes.
likely_test_scope: tests/unit/gui/test_gui_backtest.py: primary chart pages at 1600x900 with selected identity
dedup_hints: Search Canonical Queue for IndividualEquityPage clipping, right rail, identity detail.

findings.title: Research empty chart looks numeric and OHLCV columns are clipped
findings.exact_reproduction: Open Research Workspace at 1600x900 with no selected symbol and inspect the chart/OHLCV panels.
findings.expected: The chart has an explicit unavailable overlay and the OHLCV table exposes all column meanings without clipped headers.
findings.actual: The blank chart renders default numeric axes (0.2–0.8), while the fixed-width OHLCV panel cuts headers after high and relies on a tiny horizontal scrollbar.
likely_code_scope: src/stock_data/gui/main_window.py: ResearchWorkspacePage empty-state overlay and splitter/table sizing
dedup_hints: Search Canonical Queue for Research Workspace empty chart axes or OHLCV header clipping.

findings.title: Current candidate refresh terminates in LOCAL_CANDIDATE_READ_FAILED
findings.exact_reproduction: Open Research Workspace, click 현재 후보 새로고침 with a real mouse event, wait until the managed candidate worker finishes.
findings.expected: The retained local scan loads candidates, or a precise missing/corrupt input reason identifies the recovery action.
findings.actual: The terminal feedback is '현재 후보를 읽지 못했습니다 (LOCAL_CANDIDATE_READ_FAILED)' with zero candidate rows; it does not identify the failing retained input.
findings.latency_feedback: Worker completed; failure is visible after completion.
dedup_hints: Search Canonical Queue for LOCAL_CANDIDATE_READ_FAILED, exploratory candidate scanner, retained scan path.

findings.title: Windows full-page navigation emits negative QFont point-size warnings
findings.exact_reproduction: Run test_windows_full_page_navigation_uses_positive_fonts_without_qt_warning with QT_SCALE_FACTOR=1 and QT_ENABLE_HIGHDPI_SCALING=0 on native Windows.
findings.expected: All page/chart fonts retain positive point sizes and the focused Windows navigation test passes without QFont warnings.
findings.actual: The focused test fails after navigation with repeated 'QFont::setPointSizeF: Point size <= 0 (-0.750000)' messages; six sibling focused GUI tests pass.
findings.latency_feedback: Deterministic during the 11.78s focused test selection.
dedup_hints: Search Canonical Queue for QFont setPointSizeF -0.75, Windows navigation, account chart fonts.
